problems: The blind guess (fish or bird) does not match the intended subject, the Gale's Tooth. The silhouette is not readable as a tooth without the title: the blue outline is irregular and has spiky detours, so it does not read as a crown with roots.
The gold lines carry the shape. The blue outline is only a loose contour that wanders away from the gold path, so the figure reads as a set of connected lines rather than a solid silhouette.

Crown and roots are present and the figure is upright (crown at top, roots pointing down), which is correct. The bottom root tip 40888 and the right root tip 37504 sit near the bottom, and the left root tip 50954 sits low-left.

Stars sit roughly on their parts: top-left cusp 48002, top-right cusp 40680, middle of the top edge 44382, left crown corner 50083, enamel point 50099 on the left crown, pulp chamber 45238 at the centre inside its ellipse, and root canal 44599 on the central line down to the bottom root.
Stray unlabelled stars (around (392,147), (272,261), (88,328), (97,363)) sit outside the figure. Remove them or keep them clearly apart from the silhouette.
The right shoulder 39794 is placed on the right edge of the crown, but the outline bends in and out there, which adds confusion around the right side of the crown.
output.advice:
Redraw as a clean, closed tooth silhouette, upright, crown on top and two or three roots below, filled or outlined as one contour rather than a loose path.

Crown outline, clockwise from the left: left corner of the crown 50083 (about x=108, y=265) up to top-left cusp 48002 (about x=153, y=110), then across the top edge through middle-of-top-edge 44382 (about x=286, y=143) to top-right cusp 40680 (about x=416, y=137), then down to right shoulder 39794 (about x=424, y=228).

Right side: from right shoulder 39794 down and out to the right root tip 37504 (about x=447, y=355) on the right root.

Bottom: from right root tip 37504 down-left to bottom root tip 40888 (about x=337, y=468), then back up to a notch near the root canal 44599 (about x=271, y=320), then down-left to left root tip 50954 (about x=118, y=380).

Left side: from left root tip 50954 back up to enamel point 50099 (about x=109, y=265), which sits on the left edge of the crown, then close the contour to 50083.

Interior: put pulp chamber 45238 at the centre (about x=255, y=237) as a small ellipse (the pulp chamber), with root canal 44599 running from the pulp chamber down the centre to the bottom root tip 40888. Place right edge of the pulp chamber 42425 (about x=337, y=262) on the right wall of that ellipse.

Remove the stray unlabelled stars and the spiky side detours of the blue path. Keep the gold lines as the labelled skeleton, but make the blue silhouette follow the same contour so the tooth reads without the title."
